item.title: HJCD-IK: GPU-Accelerated Inverse Kinematics through Batched Hybrid Jacobian Coordinate Descent
item.description: We introduce HJCD-IK, a GPU-accelerated, sampling-based hybrid solver. By pairing a novel orientation-aware greedy coordinate descent initialization with Jacobian-based polishing and a parallel collision filter, our method achieves up to order-of-magnitude gains in speed and accuracy over state-of-the-art solvers, consistently finding collision-free solutions on the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier, while producing a diverse distribution of high-quality samples. We validate our solver on a physical Franka manipulator and release our code open-source.
